items.q: Do I need a new phone number to use Melpis?
items.a: No. You can connect your existing WhatsApp Business number via the official Meta Cloud API, or use a dedicated number if you prefer keeping channels separate.

items.q: How do I manage chat conversations and can I use it from my phone?
items.a: Melpis integrates via the official Meta Cloud API. Reading and replying manually takes place directly inside the Melpis Shared Inbox (accessible via web on computers, tablets, or smartphones). The assistant replies in real time and notifies you immediately when human intervention is needed.

items.q: What happens if the assistant receives a complex or unknown request?
items.a: Melpis replies strictly using the documents and rules you provide. If an inquiry covers missing information or requires special arrangements, the assistant will not improvise: it politely informs the customer and hands off the ticket to your staff in the Inbox.

items.q: How long does the initial setup take?
items.a: Basic setup takes just a few minutes: connect your WhatsApp channel, upload your business info (hours, services, or menu), and configure response rules. You can test your assistant immediately in the built-in simulator before going live.

items.q: How does the 7-day free trial work?
items.a: The trial ends after 7 days or 150 AI messages, whichever comes first. No credit card is required and there is no automatic renewal. When the message limit is reached, AI replies stop and requests are handed to an operator.

items.q: Is customer data secure and GDPR-compliant?
items.a: Yes. Melpis enforces strict tenant-level data isolation, encryption at rest (Fernet), consent and opt-out tracking, and never uses your customer data to train third-party language models.

items.q: Can I customize the assistant's tone of voice and response guidelines?
items.a: Yes. From your dashboard, you can define custom instructions, choose formality levels, set booking boundaries, and designate specific topics that always require manual operator confirmation.

items.q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
items.a: Yes, you can manage or cancel your subscription at any time directly through the integrated Stripe billing portal in your settings, with no lock-in contracts or penalty fees.
